skills.name: get_system_information
skills.description: Read fresh, timestamped facts from this computer. Choose overview, cpu, memory, disks, battery, temperatures, hardware (CPU/GPU), os, network, displays, audio, services, processes, or packages. Results include sources and explicit partial/unavailable errors. Never infer missing values or reuse old readings as current facts.

detail.description: Optional exact service/package or section-specific filter. This is data, never a shell command.

skills.name: get_system_control_status
skills.description: Read current control settings and the installed control-panel integration. Reports source evidence and unsupported/unavailable states for audio, display, network, Bluetooth, power, notifications and theme without changing settings.
